==== types.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// The program's types, named as in its Go and Rust: structs as interfaces,
// enums as unions discriminated by tag, arrays and maps read-only.

/** A typedef. */
export interface Item {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly type: string;
  readonly tags: readonly string[];
  readonly price: number;
}

/** A tree of labels. */
export interface Tree {
  readonly label: string;
  readonly kids: readonly Tree[];
}

/** A typedef. */
export interface Inventory {
  readonly by_id: ReadonlyMap<number, Item>;
  readonly grid: readonly (readonly number[])[];
  readonly groups: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly Item[]>;
  readonly best: OptItem;
  readonly flags: ReadonlyMap<number, boolean>;
  readonly tree: Tree;
  readonly note: OptString;
}

/** The type of the typedef Opt<Item>. */
export type OptItem =
  | { readonly tag: "None" }
  | { readonly tag: "Some"; readonly value: Item };

/** The type of the typedef Opt<string>. */
export type OptString =
  | { readonly tag: "None" }
  | { readonly tag: "Some"; readonly value: string };

/** The type of the parameters of Echo. */
export interface EchoArgs {
  readonly inv: Inventory;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Count. */
export interface CountArgs {
  readonly inv: Inventory;
  readonly extra: readonly (readonly number[])[];
  readonly in: number;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Pick. */
export interface PickArgs {
  readonly t: Tree;
  readonly note: OptString;
}

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/**
 * Gives the inventory back as it came.
 *
 * Runs proc Echo: `POST /api/echo` on http server web-api.
 */
export async function echo(args: { readonly inv: $t.Inventory }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<$t.Inventory> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/echo", {
    "inv": $enc_Inventory(args.inv),
  }, opts);
  return $dec_Inventory(v, "result");
}

/**
 * Counts the items by id, the grid's rows and the extra rows, plus in.
 *
 * Runs proc Count: `GET /api/count` on http server web-api.
 */
export async function count(args: { readonly inv: $t.Inventory; readonly extra: readonly (readonly number[])[]; readonly in: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/api/count", {
    "inv": $enc_Inventory(args.inv),
    "extra": $encList($encList($encFloat))(args.extra),
    "in": $encInt(args.in),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

/**
 * The tree's label, or the note's.
 *
 * Runs proc Pick: `POST /api/pick` on http server web-api.
 */
export async function pick(args: { readonly t: $t.Tree; readonly note: $t.OptString }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<$t.OptString> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/pick", {
    "t": $enc_Tree(args.t),
    "note": $enc_OptString(args.note),
  }, opts);
  return $dec_OptString(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_Item(x: $t.Item): unknown {
  return {
    "name": $encString(x.name),
    "type": $encString(x.type),
    "tags": $encList($encString)(x.tags),
    "price": $encFloat(x.price),
  };
}

export function $dec_Item(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Item {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    name: $decString($field(o, "name", at), at + ".name"),
    type: $decString($field(o, "type", at), at + ".type"),
    tags: $decList($decString)($field(o, "tags", at), at + ".tags"),
    price: $decFloat($field(o, "price", at), at + ".price"),
  };
}

export function $enc_Tree(x: $t.Tree): unknown {
  return {
    "label": $encString(x.label),
    "kids": $encList($enc_Tree)(x.kids),
  };
}

export function $dec_Tree(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Tree {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    label: $decString($field(o, "label", at), at + ".label"),
    kids: $decList($dec_Tree)($field(o, "kids", at), at + ".kids"),
  };
}

export function $enc_Inventory(x: $t.Inventory): unknown {
  return {
    "by_id": $encMap($intKey, $enc_Item)(x.by_id),
    "grid": $encList($encList($encInt))(x.grid),
    "groups": $encMap($stringKey, $encList($enc_Item))(x.groups),
    "best": $enc_OptItem(x.best),
    "flags": $encMap($intKey, $encBool)(x.flags),
    "tree": $enc_Tree(x.tree),
    "note": $enc_OptString(x.note),
  };
}

export function $dec_Inventory(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Inventory {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    by_id: $decMap($intKey, $dec_Item)($field(o, "by_id", at), at + ".by_id"),
    grid: $decList($decList($decInt))($field(o, "grid", at), at + ".grid"),
    groups: $decMap($stringKey, $decList($dec_Item))($field(o, "groups", at), at + ".groups"),
    best: $dec_OptItem($field(o, "best", at), at + ".best"),
    flags: $decMap($intKey, $decBool)($field(o, "flags", at), at + ".flags"),
    tree: $dec_Tree($field(o, "tree", at), at + ".tree"),
    note: $dec_OptString($field(o, "note", at), at + ".note"),
  };
}

export function $enc_OptItem(x: $t.OptItem): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "None") return "None";
  if (x.tag === "Some") return { "Some": $enc_Item(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "OptItem");
}

export function $dec_OptItem(v: unknown, at: string): $t.OptItem {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "None" && p === $bare) return { tag: "None" };
  if (tag === "Some" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Some", value: $dec_Item(p, at + ".Some") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "OptItem");
}

export function $enc_OptString(x: $t.OptString): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "None") return "None";
  if (x.tag === "Some") return { "Some": $encString(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "OptString");
}

export function $dec_OptString(v: unknown, at: string): $t.OptString {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "None" && p === $bare) return { tag: "None" };
  if (tag === "Some" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Some", value: $decString(p, at + ".Some") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "OptString");
}

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";
import type * as $t from "./types";

/**
 * Gives the inventory back as it came.
 *
 * Runs proc Echo through echo (`POST /api/echo` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useEcho(args?: { readonly inv: $t.Inventory } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly inv: $t.Inventory }, $t.Inventory> {
  return $useCall($c.echo, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Counts the items by id, the grid's rows and the extra rows, plus in.
 *
 * Runs proc Count through count (`GET /api/count` on http server web-api):
 * with args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */

  return $useCall($c.count, args, opts);
}

/**
 * The tree's label, or the note's.
 *
 * Runs proc Pick through pick (`POST /api/pick` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function usePick(args?: { readonly t: $t.Tree; readonly note: $t.OptString } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly t: $t.Tree; readonly note: $t.OptString }, $t.OptString> {
  return $useCall($c.pick, args, opts);
}
